cases.disposition_reason: holla --scenario parity-files --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40 with HOLLA_NO_HISTORY=1 opens the finder on ~/work/notes. parity.rs files() sets that cwd and HOME /Users/alex. The catalog row is Browse ~/work/notes (catalog.rs browse.files, Browse plus location.cwd_short). Paste that label and Enter. The title is Files · ~/work/notes (FilesPage::render) and the listing has todo.md, README.md, and 2 entries. index.html, assets, and ~/work/site are absent. Esc is shell Back (files.rs on_key, KeyCode::Esc goes to Go::Pop) and returns to the finder on Browse ~/work/notes. The shell cwd chip stays ~/work/notes. Files · and todo.md are gone. No Quit holla dialog is drawn. finish() sends Ctrl+Q and exits 0. Clean stakes return Ok from LeaveGuard::request, so request_quit does not open a dialog.
cases.entry_path: launch holla --scenario parity-files --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; paste Browse ~/work/notes; Enter
cases.return_path: Esc returns to the finder on Browse ~/work/notes; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: parity-files opens Files · ~/work/notes with todo.md, README.md, and 2 entries. Left is go_parent, the same on_key arm as Backspace (files.rs). The parent title is Files · ~/work. It is not ~/work/site and it is not /. The listing has app, notes, and link-to-app, and the remembered row is notes. Home selects the real directory app. That row says directory and does not say link-to-app. Enter calls open_current, which follows a symlink to its target, so the symlink is the wrong row. The open title is Files · ~/work/app. The listing has README.md and src, and not index.html, todo.md, or link-to-app. That open directory is the checkpoint, at 120×40 and then at 80×24, before Left. The narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Left returns to Files · ~/work and the selection is app. It does not jump to ~/work/notes or ~/work/site. Further Left reaches Files · /. One more Backspace sets Already at the root (FilesPage::go_parent when Fs::parent is None) and the title stays /. It does not become ~ or ~/work/notes. No Quit holla dialog is drawn. finish() exits 0. The shell cwd chip stays ~/work/notes throughout, because location.cwd is not the browser directory.
cases.action_sequence: From parity-files, open the real app directory, capture it, return to the parent, and stop at the root boundary.
cases.expected_results: The visible path is ~/work/app and then ~/work. The root stays /.
cases.forbidden_effects: Parent jumps to an unrelated directory.
